query:
SELECT u.id, u.openId, u.name, u.email, u.role, u.subscriptionPlan, u.loginMethod,
       w.ativo AS whitelist_ativo
FROM users u
LEFT JOIN access_whitelist w ON w.email = u.email
WHERE u.openId IN ('test-admin-promptjur-001', 'test-user-promptjur-002');
